purpose: Portable authority for comparing first-pass cascade cost with an equivalent direct accepted-result cost and for classifying bounded Finalizer repair versus rebuild.

cost_ledger.rule: Token rates, model labels, and task estimates cannot establish savings. A savings decision requires two equivalent accepted-result identities and observed component costs.

task_class_telemetry.default_rule: KEEP_CASCADE_DEFAULT only after at least three accepted observations, every observed ratio is at or below 0.75, and no observation is REBUILD_REQUIRED.
task_class_telemetry.unproven_rule: Fewer than three observations or any missing accepted-result proof remains UNPROVEN and cannot be presented as demonstrated savings.

finalizer_rewrite.warning: A one-third relevant-hunk replacement is an early warning only. It is not, by itself, proof of a rebuild.

privacy: Cost and rewrite telemetry is typed, secret-free, content-addressed, and retained by project policy. It never grants Product acceptance, deployment, spending, or owner authority.
